text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
On a stage adorned with cherry blossoms in 
full bloom, this year's "Oka Sho" has 
begun!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will be the one to seize the glory and 
claim the Tiara?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That girl Hishi Amazon... Wasn't she in 
the Hanshin JF too?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently so. Word is she's a strong 
contender for this year's Triple Tiara.

People looking forward to seeing Hishi 
Amazon run had started trickling into the 
venue.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! My bad, my bad, I spaced out for a 
second!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, the Triple Tiara route 
was chosen specifically to challenge 
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But— now that I've actually come here like 
this, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like this was a path I just had to 
walk in order to prove my new self.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what am I even saying! Sorry, 
forget I said anything!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"First, one win! I'll give it everything 
I've got!"

With a valiant smile, the Oka Sho got 
underway!
